content.markdown: Injectable interaction handler for SnlSyntaxTreeView. Class-based, async-capable. Dispatches hover/leave/click/ctrl-click with full modifier key context. ctrl_key means literal Ctrl (NOT macOS Meta). Added in v0.10.0.
